About the identification and adjustments

Three consecutive 20-second concert passages aligned in order to this separate performance of Capriccio italien. The comparison excerpt starts at 55:59 in the concert and approximately 6:17.6 in the reference. The timing estimate comes from harmonic-feature alignment and has a coarse resolution of about 0.2 seconds.

An earlier recognition stress test raised a copy of the concert excerpt by two semitones and sped it up by about 12%. Those were artificial test settings, not measured differences between these two performances. The default here is 0 semitones and 1.020× reference speed.

The measured-fit video is rendered with the timing adjustment. Pitch variants are rendered separately with duration compensation. The speed slider preserves pitch through browser time stretching where supported. Both videos remain available via their original YouTube links.
